transcript.user: whats a quick dinner i can make with eggs and rice
transcript.answer:
Fried rice is your answer — scramble some eggs, push them aside, stir-fry cooked rice
  in the same pan with the eggs, add whatever vegetables or protein you have (frozen
  peas, carrots, green onions, leftover chicken), season with soy sauce and a touch of
  sesame oil or butter. Ten minutes, done.

  If you want something faster and less fussy: rice bowl with a fried or scrambled egg
  on top, soy sauce or hot sauce, maybe some green onions if you've got them. Five
  minutes.

transcript.user: nah i dont like fried stuff
transcript.answer:
Egg fried rice isn't deep fried — it's just pan-fried, basically sautéed. But if you
  want to avoid that altogether:

  Egg drop soup — simmer rice in broth with whatever vegetables you have, then drizzle
  beaten egg into the hot broth while stirring. It poaches into silky ribbons. Season
  with soy sauce, salt, pepper. Comfort food, done in 15 minutes.

  Or baked eggs and rice — mix cooked rice with beaten eggs, milk or broth, cheese if
  you have it, salt and pepper. Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes until set. More like a
  savory custard.
